subject: Steering committee: scheduling & pre-reads for Redwood eval (FinIntegrate)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Mitchell <laura.mitchell@fintegrate.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 2 Jun 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Steering committee: scheduling & pre-reads for Redwood eval (FinIntegrate)

Hi Laura — great to connect today. Thanks for taking the time to walk through FinIntegrate's priorities. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

- Goal: Steering committee meeting to confirm decision criteria, procurement path, and timeline for a pilot (30	60 day).
- Key stakeholders we identified:
  - Economic buyer / budget owner: Laura Mitchell (you)
  - Security & legal: Rajiv Menon (CISO) and legal counsel (Elena Soto for procurement)
  - Technical champion / implementation: Marc Platt (platform lead)

Immediate asks:
1) Can you confirm those stakeholders and whether anyone else should be invited?
2) Can we target a 60-minute steering committee the week of June 8? Proposed windows below.
3) Any specific decision criteria or metrics you want to be sure we cover (e.g., latency targets, cost per 1M tokens, data residency)?

Proposed times (Pacific):
- Tue Jun 9, 10:00	11:00am PT
- Wed Jun 10, 1:00	2:00pm PT
- Thu Jun 11, 8:30	9:30am PT

I've attached a short steering committee pack and a draft SOW so stakeholders have context before the meeting. Dev will join to walk the technical agenda and prep any specific architecture questions.

Attachments: RI_Steering_Committee_Pack.pdf, SOW_Draft_v1.pdf

Thanks — happy to coordinate with your EA if you prefer.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0198

From: Laura Mitchell <laura.mitchell@fintegrate.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@fintegrate.com>, Elena Soto <elena.soto@fintegrate.com>, Marc Platt <marc.platt@fintegrate.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Jun 2026 13:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Steering committee: scheduling & pre-reads for Redwood eval (FinIntegrate)

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the clear recap. Confirming attendees: Rajiv (CISO) and Elena (procurement lead) should join; Marc will lead technical questions. Also adding our Head of Ops, Marc's manager, since this will impact runbook and support.

All three proposed windows look OK — prefer Wed Jun 10 1:00pm PT if that's still available. 

Decision criteria to cover:
- SLA/latency guarantees for peak traffic
- Security: SOC 2, data residency, encryption at rest/in transit, and audit logs retention
- Cost model: predictability for pilot vs production
- Rollout plan and integration effort (SLA for bug fixes, support tiers)

Please include a one-pager summarizing the proposed pilot model and the success metrics you recommend. Also send any security artifacts we can pre-read (SOC 2 report, data flow diagram).

Laura Mitchell
CFO / Economic Buyer
FinIntegrate
laura.mitchell@fintegrate.com

Subject: Re: Steering committee: scheduling & pre-reads for Redwood eval (FinIntegrate)

Laura — great, Wed Jun 10 1:00pm PT is confirmed on our side. I'll send a calendar invite with agenda and dial-in in a separate note.

Per your asks: attaching a one-pager (RI_Product_OnePager.pdf) with the proposed pilot model and recommended success metrics (latency p50/p95 targets, cost per 1M tokens, error rate thresholds, time-to-live for KV cache assumptions). We will also include the following security artifacts for pre-read: SOC 2 Type II summary (redacted) and a stubbed data-flow diagram.

Proposed agenda (60 min):
- 5m: Introductions & objectives (Laura)
- 15m: Business case & pilot model (Marissa)
- 20m: Technical architecture & integration ask (Dev)
- 10m: Security/compliance Qs (Rajiv)
- 10m: Procurement & next steps (Elena)

Attachments: RI_Product_OnePager.pdf (attached), plus steering pack & SOW already shared.

If there are any additional legal/compliance docs you'd like us to surface before the call, flag them and we'll bring them to the meeting.

Thanks — see you Wed.

—Marissa

Subject: Re: Steering committee: scheduling & pre-reads for Redwood eval (FinIntegrate)

Marissa / team — thanks for the materials. A couple of quick asks from security: 
1) Please provide the most recent SOC 2 Type II report (we accept a redacted version) and the controls mapping to our vendor questionnaire.
2) We will need a more detailed data flow diagram (production flows, third-party services, data at rest locations). The stub is helpful but please expand for the meeting.
3) Outline of encryption mechanisms (KMS/HSM options) and support for customer-managed keys.

If you can surface those pre-reads by EOD Monday (6/8) that would let us review before the steering committee. Looking forward to Wed.

Regards,
Rajiv
